steps.domain_action: The birth and early monastic life of Christian Rosenkreutz
The pilgrimage to the East to seek the sages of Damcar
The synthesis of mathematics, physics, and magic into a unified system
The return to Europe to share the acquired wisdom
The founding of the Fraternity of the Rosy Cross with the first three brothers
The construction of the House of the Holy Spirit as a permanent base
The decision to disseminate the Fama Fraternitatis to the world
The acceptance of the call by the sincere and the learned
The collaborative work of the brothers in healing the sick gratis
The gathering of all works into the central library of the order
The death of C.R.C. and the concealment of his burial place
The passage of time and the fading of the order from public memory
The accidental discovery of the hidden door by the third generation
The rediscovery of the body and the original documents
The simultaneous state of the vault being open yet the order remaining secret
The final sealing of the manifesto for the benefit of the learned of Europe
The closure of the narrative within the eternal vault of the spirit
